Review: Lumen Air 14 Laptop

The Lumen Air 14 weighs 1.2 kilograms and has a 14-inch screen. In our tests the battery lasted 11 hours of web browsing.

The keyboard is comfortable, but the speakers are quiet. It has two USB-C ports and no HDMI port.

The base model with 256 GB of storage costs 699 pounds.

Verdict: a light, long-lasting laptop that suits students, as long as they do not need many ports.
